'''Star Tours Flight 801''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Carosi XII]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and estimated to arrive at Gate 1B at 1650 hours. It was later scheduled to depart at 1745.
